description: BISMARCK – Julie Fedorchak today announced a coalition of veterans supporting her campaign that includes all former living Adjutants General of the North Dakota National Guard. The group is chaired by retired U.S. Marine Brian Kalk and Julie’s husband Mike Fedorchak, a veteran of the U.S. Navy. “I am honored and grateful for the support […]

title: Fedorchak Announces Veterans Coalition, Including Four Former Adjutants General of North Dakota National Guard - Julie Fedorchak
